subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should durable subagent lifecycle receipts and audited cancel/steer/resume supervision extend the current metadata-only audit ledger, the task ledger, or a dedicated subagent lifecycle API?
rationale: Current main has multiple plausible foundations, but the public API, persistence owner, retention, authorization, redaction, and supervision-action semantics require maintainer product/security intent.

options.title: Extend metadata audit ledger
options.body: Use `audit.list` as the canonical durable metadata source and add subagent-specific lifecycle and supervision actions on top.

options.title: Extend task ledger
options.body: Keep operator state under `tasks.*` and enrich task details with lifecycle receipts and action results.

options.title: Create subagent lifecycle API
options.body: Add a dedicated subagent lifecycle table/API, accepting a narrower but potentially parallel source of truth.

recommendation.title: Extend metadata audit ledger
recommendation.body: Use `audit.list` as the canonical durable metadata source and add subagent-specific lifecycle and supervision actions on top.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest product/security and current-history overlap across subagent lifecycle, audit, and gateway state surfaces.
